assets.label: workshop hoists and press
assets.service: heavy vehicle component removal and pressing

control_failures.control_label: dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: pressure release during transfer operations on HO-9403

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on HO-9403 and M-9403 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically managing corrosion and thinning findings. HO-9403 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 22 June 2024 an incident occurred on HO-9403 and M-9403 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during transfer operations, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
